intro: Three mainline stations, a central business district and two developments on Steelhouse Lane, within walking distance of all of it.
about: Birmingham is the second largest city in the UK, home to the Colmore Business District, Aston University and three mainline stations.
Our two developments on Steelhouse Lane sit in the heart of the city, a few minutes' walk from Snow Hill station.
Most of what you need is within a short walk.

items.title: Transport
items.text: Snow Hill is 4 minutes on foot, Moor Street 8 and New Street 12.

items.title: Business
items.text: Colmore Business District is 4 minutes from Steelhouse Lane.

items.title: Education
items.text: Aston University is 3 minutes on foot.

items.title: Lifestyle
items.text: The Jewellery Quarter is 10 minutes away and the Bullring 12.
